data.name: AboutBody
data.value: Lab 2: dynamic localization (RESX). This message comes from resources.

data.name: DefaultSectionTitle
data.value: Default mode: each DependencyProperty has its default mode (TextBox.Text defaults to TwoWay).

data.name: DefaultSectionSubtitle
data.value: Left: direct binding (ElementName). Right: binding to ViewModel properties.

data.name: DefaultDirectDescription
data.value: Slider → Label: the slider value is shown in the label.

data.name: DefaultTwoBoxesDescription
data.value: Two TextBoxes are TwoWay-linked via ElementName (text is mirrored).

data.name: DefaultLeftBoxHint
data.value: Hint: mirrored field. Language changes update hint and text until you edit the text.

data.name: DefaultLeftMirrorHint
data.value: Second box mirrors the first (TwoWay). Hint updates when the language changes.

data.name: DefaultVmDescription
data.value: TextBox and Label read/write DemoText. TextBox default mode is TwoWay.

data.name: TwoWaySectionTitle
data.value: Explicit TwoWay: changes flow both ways.

data.name: TwoWayDirectDescription
data.value: First field is the source for the second (live mirroring).

data.name: TwoWaySourceHint
data.value: Hint: source for the second field. Until you edit, both hint and text follow the language.

data.name: TwoWayVmDescription
data.value: TextBox ↔ UserName, Slider ↔ Volume (both explicit TwoWay).

data.name: OneTimeSectionTitle
data.value: OneTime: value is transferred once when the binding is created.

data.name: OneTimeDirectDescription
data.value: TextBlock reads TextBox only on first render (change TextBox — label will not follow).

data.name: OneTimeSeedHint
data.value: Hint: initial field value. After you edit, language changes will not overwrite your text.

data.name: OneTimeVmDescription
data.value: Label and TextBox below use OneTime to FrozenLabel. Button changes VM — UI keeps the start value.

data.name: OneTimeEditableHint
data.value: Can be changed in VM with the button — OneTime field will not update by itself

data.name: OneWaySectionTitle
data.value: OneWay: source → target only (display without writing to VM).

data.name: OneWayDirectDescription
data.value: Slider sets the number; TextBlock only shows (no reverse write).

data.name: OneWayVmDescription
data.value: Status and flags come from VM; the button changes state programmatically only.

data.name: TriggersDataDescription
data.value: DataTrigger: IsAlert in ViewModel controls border color.

data.name: TriggersHoverDescription
data.value: Trigger (IsMouseOver): hover changes background and border without ViewModel.
